title: Nexus Admin Executive Command Center

questions_answered.page_purpose: Give Ray a calm, scannable operating view of what Nexus is doing, what changed, revenue progress, blockers, decisions, and the next machine action.
ray_needs_to_learn: What changed since the last check?
questions_answered.primary_action: Open the most important current work or decision.
questions_answered.click_through: Summary items link to their canonical research, opportunity, handoff, department, or decision record.
questions_answered.visual_style: Use the existing Nexus/GoClear calm command-surface design system and approved brand assets.
avoid_raw_jargon: Do not show HEALTHY without explaining what is healthy.
Do not show bare opportunity counts without status or meaning.
Do not make internal pipeline labels the primary user-facing copy.

data_requirements: next wake and next machine action

responsive_rules.1440: Persistent navigation and two-column command surface; summary remains above detail.
responsive_rules.1024: Narrow navigation and stacked detail groups; preserve readable table/card widths.
responsive_rules.390: Single-column flow; navigation collapses; cards stack; page scrolls vertically; no horizontal overflow.

interaction_rules: Summary cards are links only when a canonical detail destination exists.
No destructive action is implied by a summary card.
accessibility_requirements: status meaning not conveyed by color alone
do_not_change_rules: Do not redesign the approved Nexus/GoClear brand system.
Do not expose secrets, tokens, or tenant identifiers.
Do not begin Codex implementation until Ray approves and the design is frozen.
